description: This file defines types, functions, and logic related to plugin activation, compatibility overrides, and configuration resolution within a plugin system, specifically for 'activation-context' handling in a project.

methods.name: applyPluginCompatibilityOverrides
methods.description: Applies compatibility overrides to the plugin configuration based on provided plugin IDs and environment.

methods.name: resolvePluginActivationSnapshot
methods.description: Resolves a snapshot of plugin activation state, optionally auto-enabling plugins based on config and environment.

methods.name: resolvePluginActivationInputs
methods.description: Resolves detailed plugin activation inputs, considering compatibility and auto-enable logic.

methods.name: resolveBundledPluginCompatibleActivationInputs
methods.description: Resolves plugin activation inputs with bundled plugin compatibility considerations, including plugin ID resolution.
